caveats: NCES EDGE private-school locations provide campus identity and coordinates but not enrollment, race, attendance, capacity, poverty, MAP, or IEP fields.
Private-school enrollment, race, teacher, grade, type, affiliation, and schedule fields are shown only when an NCES PSS detail cache row is matched by PPIN.
Private-school enrollment-growth bars use PPIN-keyed NCES PSS history and require at least two usable survey-year enrollment points.
ACS area context is residence-based Census tract data around the campus and is not school-site enrollment, poverty, or student race.
Attendance, building capacity, school-level direct certification/deep poverty, MAP performance, and IEP distribution are unavailable in the current private-school source contract.
